highlights.evidence: they process technical identifiers (ICCID, phone number, device IMEI), your network location and, for numbers, call and SMS records, as independent controllers under their own policies.

highlights.title: Trocador sees your IP
highlights.evidence: Its form loads from trocador.app, which sees your IP address and swap details under its own privacy policy.

highlights.title: Logs and retention
highlights.evidence: We keep records only as long as support, refunds, and tax law require, then delete or anonymise them.

highlights.title: Refunds in Monero
highlights.evidence: Refunds are paid in Monero to an address you give us. Check it before you send it: crypto payments cannot be reversed.

highlights.title: No refund once installed
highlights.evidence: **Installed and working:** treated as used, so not refundable.

highlights.title: Verification codes not covered
highlights.evidence: A code that never arrives or a declined sign-up is not a fault and is not grounds for a refund.

highlights.title: Server logs, no set period
highlights.evidence: **Short-lived server logs** for security and abuse prevention. Basis: legitimate interest.

highlights.title: Ban at any time
highlights.evidence: XmrBazaar can ban members at any time for any reason.

highlights.title: No refunds from platform
highlights.evidence: XmrBazaar cannot refund lost money or products.

highlights.title: No custody of funds
highlights.evidence: XmrBazaar never holds custody of any users’ Monero or Monero private keys, is never able to access any users’ Monero or wallets, can not view the transactions being made among users

highlights.title: Escrow beta risk
highlights.evidence: XmrBazaar is still in beta and the escrow feature may still have bugs. Be careful with using the escrow feature for large amounts.

highlights.title: Data stored
highlights.evidence: XmrBazaar does not store IP addresses and does not use analytics.

highlights.title: IP visible to server
highlights.evidence: XmrBazaar does not log IP addresses, however the user’s IP address is still visible to the server while connecting and the user’s ISP can see that the user visited XmrBazaar.

highlights.title: Sign-up needs no ID
highlights.evidence: XmrBazaar does not require KYC and can be used pseudonymously. Users only need to provide a username and password. An email address is optional for password resets and notifications.

highlights.title: Liability disclaimer
highlights.evidence: XmrBazaar holds no responsibility or liability for any losses, including but not limited to loss of money, loss of products, failed transactions, scams or hacks

highlights.title: No custody of funds
highlights.evidence: A 2-of-3 multisig wallet is generated in the user’s browser (via Monero JavaScript) and is never sent to the server.

highlights.title: Stored account data
highlights.evidence: XmrBazaar stores the following information: User info (username, hash of password, email address, avatar, bio, Monero address, PGP public key);

highlights.title: Account recovery limits
highlights.evidence: If not, please make a temporary account and then message the [admin AilliA](https://xmrbazaar.com/messenger/AilliA/) to recover your account manually.

highlights.title: Mediator decides disputes
highlights.evidence: In the case of a dispute, the mediator must decide whether to refund the buyer (buyer and mediator sign and broadcast the refund transaction) or payout the seller (seller and mediator sign and broadcast the payout transaction).

highlights.title: Listing removal unexplained
highlights.evidence: XmrBazaar, without needing to explain its reasoning, can determine whether a listing is high-risk.
